cohort: 64 pregnant women undergoing cesarean delivery, 32 with antepartum hemorrhage (APH) and 32 without (non-APH).
finding: Microscopic evaluation of endomyometrium in women with APH revealed hemorrhage, abnormal vascular structure, absent decidual changes, direct contact between placenta and myometrium, higher trophoblast infiltration, and decreased villous fibrin deposition compared to women without APH.
